How to play
  1. Press and drag on the slab to work each tool. During the pour, switch between the chute and the rake.
  2. Hold fast-forward while bleed water comes and goes. It speeds up the longer you hold and brakes when the window opens.
  3. Watch the weather. If rain rolls in, hit Tarp it fast.
  4. Thumb test tells you how firm it is. The amber bracket on the meter is the right time for the tool in hand.
  5. Tap View for crew, overhead, low and close-up angles.

Leaderboard

Points = job score × weather bonus (Easy ×0.8, Normal ×1, Hard ×1.35, Cold ×1.15) × 10. Your best on each job counts. Overall adds up your bests across every job. Design Your Own is practice and isn't ranked.
